short: Minkowski’s bound on finite matrix groups

lean.name: minkowski_bound_rat
lean.plain: Minkowski’s bound on finite matrix groups
lean.note: The finite class sums involve denominators from the orders of stabilisers. Minkowski’s theorem controls these uniformly because the order of every finite subgroup of $\operatorname{GL}_N(\mathbb Q)$ divides the same explicit integer depending only on $N$.
